docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Śarat Candra's short novel (1917) of Devdās, Pārvatī and Candramukhī, the best-loved tragic love story of Bengali literature, in its sixteen chapters.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Śarat Candra Caṭṭopādhyāẏ (Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, 1876–1938), Debdās (1917), as transcribed on Bengali Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
